title: Farewell, Unova! Setting Sail for New Adventures!
overview: As our heroes prepare to enjoy the next chapter of their exciting adventures, others have different plans!

title: Danger, Sweet as Honey!
overview: As our heroes begin exploring the Decolore Islands, their first stop starts off as a not-so-sweet experience!

title: Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!
overview: As our heroes continue their Decolore Island-hopping cruise, a shipboard theft calls for some super-Connoisseur sleuthing!

title: Crowning the Scalchop King!
overview: Arriving on Scalchop Island, our heroes decide to participate in an unusual competition!

title: The Island of Illusions!
overview: A deserted island gives our heroes the opportunity to witness what enduring friendship is all about!

title: To Catch a Rotom!
overview: Arriving on Torom Island, our heroes meet up with an old friend on an important research mission!

title: The Pirates of Decolore!
overview: As our heroes continue their cruise through the Decolore Islands, a surprise visit by a quartet of unusual pirates changes everyone's course!

title: Butterfree and Me!
overview: As our heroes continue their tour of the Decolore Islands by ship, one island in particular offers them a chance to change a life for the better-forever!

title: The Path That Leads to Goodbye!
overview: Exploring Capacia Island on their way to the Kanto region, little do our heroes know that the path they're on leads to a place they never imagined!

title: Searching for a Wish!
overview: Visiting a seemingly lifeless part of Capacia Island, our heroes come upon a life-giving solution to its dilemma!

title: Capacia Island UFO!
overview: A bright light in the night sky gives our heroes a strange change of pace...and face!

title: The Journalist from Another Region!
overview: As our heroes continue their tour of the Decolore Islands, they encounter a windfall of delicious berries and unexpected new friends!

title: Mystery on a Deserted Island!
overview: Arriving on a deserted island on a quest for treasure, our heroes find something much more precious than they anticipated!

title: A Pokémon of a Different Color!
overview: When Ash runs into an old friend en route to the Kanto region, Iris discovers a true kindred spirit!

title: Celebrating the Hero's Comet!
overview: As our heroes continue their tour of the Decolore Islands, an upcoming celestial event sets the stage for celestial intrigue and delight!

title: Go, Go, Gogoat!
overview: Visiting a Pokémon Center while touring the Decolore Islands, a surprise detour challenges our heroes to help some new friends in need!

title: Team Rocket's Shocking Recruit!
overview: A playful island moment turns into a big misunderstanding, and our heroes are about to face a major challenge!

title: Survival of the Striaton Gym!
overview: Cilan's brothers arrive for a surprise visit, bringing with them the challenge of a lifetime!

title: Best Wishes! Until We Meet Again!
overview: As our heroes near Vermilion City and the end of their shipboard adventures, one familiar challenge forces them to spring into action!

title: The Dream Continues!
overview: A visit to Pallet Town to see family and friends shows just how enduring Ash's dreams really are!

title: Dent to Takeshi! Gyarados no Gekirin!
overview: Dent visits Johto on a fishing trip and finds a Gyarados who is behaving oddly. He relays the information to the local Pokémon Center, where Takeshi is working, and an investigation commences.
